Title: Azure DevTest Labs - Create a network isolated lab

Body.Content:
We are announcing that Azure DevTest Labs customers can create a network isolated lab.

An Azure Virtual Network helps ensure that private network traffic is logically isolated from outside traffic. Each lab can be configured with an Azure network to ensure virtual machines and environments created within are isolated from unwanted traffic and follow enterprise networking policies.

Lab owners can also now create a network isolated lab. This means, alongside isolating lab virtual machines and environments to a selected network, lab owners can also isolate the lab storage account and key vaults created for certain lab operations.

Learn more about how you can create an isolated network lab.
